description: Pinned Chrome-for-Testing (Chromium) Linux build for No Cache Browser. This product is the NCB host — we do not ship or default to system Google Chrome.
notes: Default resolve: EngineStartConfig.chromiumPath → NCB_CHROMIUM_PATH → bundled third_party/chromium/chrome (via npm run fetch-chromium).
System Chromium/Chrome is used ONLY when NCB_ALLOW_SYSTEM_CHROMIUM=1 (or true); searchPaths are an opt-in allowlist, not the default.
MIT license covers No Cache Browser source only; Chromium/CfT is a separate dependency with its own license.
Set NCB_CHROMIUM_NO_SANDBOX=1 in containers/CI if the setuid sandbox fails.
